verdict.rationale: The pack documents general AI features: pre-built AI agents (AI Teammates), AI Studio described as "powerful no-code automations," and an MCP server for task management. None of these items say that AI automatically triages, routes, or prioritizes incoming bugs or tasks. The integrations that create tasks from Sentry, GitLab or Jira only cover intake and sync, with no AI-based prioritization, so they are adjacent at most.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI automatically triage and prioritize incoming bugs and tasks
